content: testcontainers-python provides a PostgresContainer fixture (module or session scoped) to spin up real Postgres for integration tests; pairs with SQLAlchemy async engine or asyncpg pool fixtures. Common pattern: session-scoped container + function-scoped transaction rollback for isolation. Recommended for verifying the Postgres SQL impl's real row-lock behavior (can't be verified against SQLite, which has no true row locks) and for concurrency tests simulating concurrent hold attempts.
